records.jp: あっ、船長。そろそろ土星が見えてきましたー！<CR>なーんて！
records.en_original: Captain! We have visual confirmation of Saturn! Hehe!
records.en_auxiliary: Captain! We have visual confirmation of Saturn! Hehe!
records.en: Ah, Captain! Saturn is coming into view!<CR>...Or something!

records.jp: 星崎隊員、そろそろ目的地は決まりましたか？
records.en_original: Have you finished plotting our course, Officer Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you finished plotting our course, Officer Hoshizaki?
records.en: Crew Member Hoshizaki, have you decided on our destination?

records.jp: （あ、美弦さんが付き合ってくれてる！）
records.en_original: (Oh, Mio's playing along!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, Mio's playing along!)
records.en: (Oh, Mio-san's playing along!)

records.jp: えーとですね
records.en_original: Yes ma'am.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes ma'am.
records.en: Let's see...

records.jp: 宇宙の果てまでどこまでも、であります！
records.en_original: To the end of the universe, and beyond!
records.en_auxiliary: To the end of the universe, and beyond!
records.en: As far as we can go, to the end of space!

records.jp: それは長い長い旅ね
records.en_original: That will be quite the long journey.
records.en_auxiliary: That will be quite the long journey.
records.en: That will be quite the long journey.

records.jp: 宇宙の果てって、何があるのかなぁ
records.en_original: I wonder what we'd find there.
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what we'd find there.
records.en: I wonder what we'd find there.

records.jp: もちろん、平原船長のハートであります！
records.en_original: I have my sights set on Captain Hirahara's heart!
records.en_auxiliary: I have my sights set on Captain Hirahara's heart!
records.en: Of course, Captain Hirahara's heart!

records.jp: 私の、ハート！？
records.en_original: My heart?!
records.en_auxiliary: My heart?!
records.en: My heart?!

records.jp: うん！　一緒に旅ができたら、美弦さんのことを<CR>もっと知ることができそう！
records.en_original: Yeah! Since we're traveling together, I can get to know you better!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Since we're traveling together, I can get to know you better!
records.en: Yeah! If we can travel together, Mio-san,<CR>I feel like I could learn much more about you!

records.jp: そ、そういう意味ね。<CR>一瞬、ドキッとしちゃった
records.en_original: O-oh, that's what you meant. For a second, I thought...
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh, that's what you meant. For a second, I thought...
records.en: O-oh, that's what you meant.<CR>For a moment, my heart skipped a beat.

records.jp: ドキッ？
records.en_original: You thought what?
records.en_auxiliary: You thought what?
records.en: Your heart skipped?

records.jp: これが本物のロケットだったら、楽しそうだなぁ。<CR>だって……
records.en_original: It would be so cool if this were a real rocket.
records.en_auxiliary: It would be so cool if this were a real rocket.
records.en: It would be fun if this were a real rocket.<CR>Because...

records.jp: 学校が海で囲まれてても、空の上に行ってみたら、<CR>案外宇宙が広がってるかもしれないし
records.en_original: The school is surrounded by water, but if we went up into the sky, we might even discover parts of space unknown to man…
records.en_auxiliary: The school is surrounded by water, but if we went up into the sky, we might even discover parts of space unknown to man…
records.en: Even if the school is surrounded by ocean, if we went up into the sky,<CR>space might unexpectedly stretch out above us.

records.jp: なーんて、そんなことはないかぁ
records.en_original: What am I talking about? There's nothing up there.
records.en_auxiliary: What am I talking about? There's nothing up there.
records.en: Though I suppose that's not possible.

records.jp: 意外とあるかもしれないわよ？<CR>宇宙は神秘に満ちているわけだしね
records.en_original: You don't know that for sure. The universe is full of mysteries, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't know that for sure. The universe is full of mysteries, you know?
records.en: You don't know that for sure.<CR>The universe is full of mysteries, you know?

records.jp: 美弦さんって、宇宙に興味ある系？
records.en_original: Are you interested in space, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you interested in space, Mio?
records.en: Are you interested in space, Mio-san?

records.jp: ないとは言えないわね
records.en_original: A little, I suppose.
records.en_auxiliary: A little, I suppose.
records.en: I can't say I'm not.

records.jp: やっぱり、地球とは違う未知の場所だから？
records.en_original: So you're fascinated by the great unknown?
records.en_auxiliary: So you're fascinated by the great unknown?
records.en: Because it's an unknown place different from Earth?

records.jp: そうね。この世界には、まだ理解できないことが<CR>多いから……かしら
records.en_original: You could say that. There are so many things in this world we still don't understand...
records.en_auxiliary: You could say that. There are so many things in this world we still don't understand...
records.en: You could say that.<CR>There are so many things in this world we still don't understand...

records.jp: この世界の摂理が、そこに秘められているような<CR>気がして。だから惹かれるのかもしれない
records.en_original: I feel that the ultimate truth of this world is hidden out there somewhere. I think that's why I'm drawn to it.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel that the ultimate truth of this world is hidden out there somewhere. I think that's why I'm drawn to it.
records.en: I feel as though the laws of this world might be hidden there.<CR>Perhaps that's why I'm drawn to it.

records.jp: 美弦さんの考えることって、壮大だなぁ
records.en_original: You really like to think about things on a grand scale, Mio.
records.en_auxiliary: You really like to think about things on a grand scale, Mio.
records.en: You really like to think about things on a grand scale, Mio-san.

records.jp: 『男のロマン』って、何よ、愛央ったら。<CR>それはともかく……
records.en_original: "The adventurous spirit of man"? Ao, what are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: "The adventurous spirit of man"? Ao, what are you talking about?
records.en: 'A man's dream'? What are you talking about, Ao?<CR>In any case...

records.jp: ロマンを感じるのは、その通りかも。未知の領域<CR>には、未知の可能性が眠っているかもしれないもの
records.en_original: But...I think I can understand that. Who knows what unknown possibilities lay dormant in uncharted territory, waiting to be discovered?
records.en_auxiliary: But...I think I can understand that. Who knows what unknown possibilities lay dormant in uncharted territory, waiting to be discovered?
records.en: I do feel the romance of it.<CR>Unknown possibilities might lie dormant in uncharted territory.

records.jp: 未知の……可能性？
records.en_original: Unknown...possibilities?
records.en_auxiliary: Unknown...possibilities?
records.en: Unknown...possibilities?

records.jp: 希望、とかね
records.en_original: Like hope.
records.en_auxiliary: Like hope.
records.en: Like hope.

records.jp: 希望……
records.en_original: Hope...
records.en_auxiliary: Hope...
records.en: Hope...

records.jp: （美弦さん、何だか遠い目をしてる……）
records.en_original: (Mio's drifting off somewhere far away...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Mio's drifting off somewhere far away...)
records.en: (Mio-san is looking into the distance...)

records.jp: 愛央。これが本物の、どこまでも飛べる<CR>ロケットだとしたら、どこへ行ってみたい？
records.en_original: Ao. If this was a real rocket that could fly anywhere, where would you go?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. If this was a real rocket that could fly anywhere, where would you go?
records.en: Ao. If this were a real rocket that could fly<CR>anywhere, where would you want to go?

records.jp: どこまでも行けるロケット？<CR>うーん、そうだなぁ
records.en_original: If it could fly anywhere? Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: If it could fly anywhere? Hmm...
records.en: If it could fly anywhere?<CR>Hmm...

records.jp: えーと、宇宙人が住んでる惑星！<CR>私たちがファーストコンタクトするの！
records.en_original: I'd visit a planet inhabited by aliens and make first contact!
records.en_auxiliary: I'd visit a planet inhabited by aliens and make first contact!
records.en: I'd visit a planet inhabited<CR>by aliens and make first contact!

records.jp: その宇宙人って、私たちとは違う姿をしているかも<CR>しれないわよ？
records.en_original: The aliens might not look anything like us, though.
records.en_auxiliary: The aliens might not look anything like us, though.
records.en: The aliens might not look anything like us,<CR>though.

records.jp: たとえば、タコっぽいやつとか？
records.en_original: You think they'd have long tentacles or something?
records.en_auxiliary: You think they'd have long tentacles or something?
records.en: For example, something octopus-like?

records.jp: それどころか私たちから見て、おぞましい姿<CR>だったとしたら……愛央、どうする？
records.en_original: What if they actually looked horrifying to us? What would you do, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What if they actually looked horrifying to us? What would you do, Ao?
records.en: What if they actually looked horrifying to us?<CR>What would you do, Ao?

records.jp: おぞましいって……手とかいっぱいあったりとか、<CR>ぬらっとしてたりぐちゃっとしてたり……
records.en_original: Horrifying... Like if they were squishy and slimy with tons of arms...?
records.en_auxiliary: Horrifying... Like if they were squishy and slimy with tons of arms...?
records.en: Horrifying... Like having lots of arms,<CR>being slimy, or all mangled...

records.jp: うわー。想像しちゃったよー！
records.en_original: Eek! I just imagined it!
records.en_auxiliary: Eek! I just imagined it!
records.en: Eek! I just imagined it!

records.jp: ふふ。反応が見たくて、つい脅かしちゃった。<CR>ごめんなさいね、愛央
records.en_original: Hehe. I just wanted to see your reaction. Sorry, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. I just wanted to see your reaction. Sorry, Ao.
records.en: Hehe. I just wanted to see your reaction.<CR>Sorry, Ao.

records.jp: やっぱ、太陽系一周旅行！<CR>ご近所さんって気になるし？
records.en_original: I'd go on a trip around the solar system! I've always been curious about our neighbors.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd go on a trip around the solar system! I've always been curious about our neighbors.
records.en: A trip around the entire solar system!<CR>I'm curious about our neighbors, you know?

records.jp: 金星とか、都会の空でもすごく明るくて、<CR>なんかいいなーって思ってたんだー
records.en_original: You can see Venus in the night sky even from the city. I just think that's so cool...
records.en_auxiliary: You can see Venus in the night sky even from the city. I just think that's so cool...
records.en: Venus shines so brightly even in the city sky.<CR>I always thought that was nice.

records.jp: へぇ、意外ね。愛央ならもっと、<CR>とんでもないことを言い出すかと思ったわ
records.en_original: Huh, that's surprising. I was expecting something a little more outlandish from you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, that's surprising. I was expecting something a little more outlandish from you, Ao.
records.en: Huh, that's surprising.<CR>I was expecting something a little more outlandish from you, Ao.

records.jp: えー。美弦さんの中で、<CR>私ってどーゆーイメージなわけー！？
records.en_original: Huh? Wait, what exactly did you think I would say?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Wait, what exactly did you think I would say?!
records.en: Hey, Mio-san!<CR>What kind of image do you have of me?!

records.jp: だって、意外と堅実なんだもの
records.en_original: Nothing, it was just surprisingly down-to-earth.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing, it was just surprisingly down-to-earth.
records.en: Because it's surprisingly down-to-earth.

records.jp: もっとずっと先のことかもしれないけれど、<CR>太陽系内の旅なら、十分に現実になり得る範囲よ
records.en_original: It might still be a ways off, but a trip around the solar system is within the realm of possibility.
records.en_auxiliary: It might still be a ways off, but a trip around the solar system is within the realm of possibility.
records.en: It may be far in the future,<CR>but travel within the solar system is well within the realm of possibility.

records.jp: といっても、各惑星に降り立てるかどうかは<CR>別問題になるけれど
records.en_original: Whether we could land on the planets and walk on their surfaces is a different story, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Whether we could land on the planets and walk on their surfaces is a different story, though.
records.en: Whether we could land on the planets and walk on their surfaces is a different story,<CR>though.

records.jp: んー。でも、ロケットから見るだけでも<CR>楽しそうな気がする！
records.en_original: Hmm. It'd still be nice to see them up close, even if it was from inside the rocket!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. It'd still be nice to see them up close, even if it was from inside the rocket!
records.en: Hmm. It'd still be nice to see them up close,<CR>even if it was from inside the rocket!

records.jp: 美弦さんの解説付きで、行ってみたいなぁ
records.en_original: And I'd like to listen to your commentary along the way.
records.en_auxiliary: And I'd like to listen to your commentary along the way.
records.en: I'd like to go with your explanations along the way, Mio-san.

records.jp: ふふ。それは楽しそうね
records.en_original: Hehe, that sounds fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, that sounds fun.
records.en: Hehe, that sounds fun.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
